data.why: The app loads aligned_data.xlsx, which already ships in the repository next to aligned_app.py and is not a user upload, so nothing needs to be copied or written.

goals: Get a quick overall read on how EC Country Reports frame Serbia's reform progress across all years (Full Picture preset, Trend view)
Compare political versus economic criteria over time (Pol. vs Econ. preset)
Compare domestic reform effort versus international cooperation effort over time (Dom. vs Intl. preset)
Drill into specific topics (e.g. Judiciary, Freedom of Expression) via the free topic multiselect and view them ranked by average score
Apply the World-Systems Analysis lens to see how EU-core primary vs secondary interest topics score, optionally disaggregated into individual topics
Narrow to a sub-range of years with the year-range slider and export the resulting chart (SVG/HTML) and underlying data (CSV) for use outside the dashboard

review.summary: The tree captures the dashboard's purpose and covers nearly everything the README and code offer, at a sensible depth with faithful labels; every screen I opened (10) supports its node. It needs only small fixes: one label is missing its year range, two features overlap on the WSA lens, and a citation feature is missing.
